$comment: Evidence map for Phase 41. The current repository contains sandbox architecture text but no dedicated universal sandbox acceptance suite; all criteria remain declared.

areas.area: Sandbox isolation and lifecycle are defined
areas.requirement: Sandbox state, grants, credentials, lifecycle and resource boundaries isolate simulated realities from production.

areas.area: Promotion from sandbox is proposal-only and audited
areas.requirement: Sandbox output cannot write canonical reality; promotion requires validation, policy, approval and audit.

areas.area: Sandbox execution, cleanup and operational evidence are wired
areas.requirement: Sandbox runs execute with scoped credentials, bounded resources, escape detection, cleanup and reproducible evidence.
